_comment: Template modelled on talos-cluster/bonbon/gateway/production.json. Provision with `airs gateway mcp integrations` as for Bonbon; pass secrets via --configurations. PLACEHOLDERs are new airs-mcp registrations, never Bonbon IDs.
name: airs

user_identity_forwarding._required_for_m1: A signed per-backend binding: `aud` = https://mcp-backend-airs.goshawks.io/mcp, or a per-integration signing key (contract §2.2). Record whether the gateway supports either; if not, M0.6 fails P1.
